entities.summary: María Pía Adriasola Barroilhet is a Chilean lawyer and activist. She is the wife of José Antonio Kast, president of Chile, whose government is expected to formally reinstate the position of First Lady of Chile, which Adriasola has publicly expressed her intention to assume.
